'''Viril Shu''' was a corporate magnate on<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|Corellian Run Scoundrels}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Denon/Legends|Denon]] who had a [[Viril Shu's daughter|daughter]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Codex" /> As Denon was located along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]],<ref name="Atlas" /> the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang known as the [[Corellian Run Scoundrels]] often targeted the world, and legend had it that the Scoundrels' [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Kai Zykken]] kidnapped Shu's daughter in an unsuccessful attempt to woo her into [[Marriage/Legends|marrying]] himself so that he could inherit Shu's fortune.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Viril Shu was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Corellian Run Scoundrels in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']], the [[2014]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
